name: 蔣榮
objective: This course covers insightful topics and advanced knowledge in foundation engineering, including site investigation, foundation design, bearing capacity, slope stability, and pile foundations. It also addresses soil improvement techniques, lateral earth pressure, and the use of geosynthetics in reinforced structures. Students will apply their knowledge through assignments and a term project.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Geotechnical Site Investigation
Week 3: Principles of Foundation Design
Week 4: Ultimate Bearing Capacity of Shallow Foundations
Week 5: Excavation
Week 6: Pile Foundations
Week 7: Slope Stability
Week 8: Numerical Analysis in Geotechnical Engineering
Week 9: Invited Lecture
Week 10: Types of Earth Retaining Structures (ERS) and Lateral Earth Pressure
Week 11: Geosynthetics and Reinforced Structures
Week 12: Design of Mechanically Stabilized Earth (MSE) Walls
Week 13: Soil Improvement and Ground Modification (1)
Week 14: Soil Improvement and Ground Modification (2)
Week 15: Invited Lecture
Week 16: Special Lecture
Week 17: Term Project (1)
Week 18: Term Project (2)
scorePolicy:
Participation: 10%
Class Performance: 30%
Assignments: 20%
Term Project: 40%
materials: Course materials will be prepared by the instructor in ppt format. Some content will be taught using board writing.
consultation: Office hours: Anytime the instructor is in the office (or by appointment).
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
